_comment:: workspaces: the scene type corresponding to each BDDL file
bddl_file_names: BDDL files to be used for data generation
language_instructions: language instructions corresponding to each BDDL file, i.e. a mission, feel free to change it if necessary
running_layout_ids: layout/scenes indices to be used for data generation, e.g. [0] means only the first bddl in bddl_file_name will be used
high_level_preferences: a list of high-level preferences that will be used during data generation
enabled_high_pref_ids: the indices of high-level preferences to be enabled during data generation
low_pref_type:a list of low-level preferences that can be used during data generation
enabled_low_pref_ids: the indices of high-level preferences to be enabled during data generation
